info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Parking Reservations Violations-v5-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Violations API provides access to a comprehensive list of violations associated with parking reservations. It allows clients to retrieve details about specific violations, helping stakeholders such as parking administrators and compliance officers to monitor compliance and address issues. This API is particularly useful for applications that manage parking systems, enabling effective oversight and management of reservations. Users can utilize this API to enhance reporting, conduct audits, and improve overall operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of violation records associated with reservations.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch details about violations related to specific reservations. It can be used to monitor compliance, manage exceptions, and ensure adherence to regulations regarding reservation handling.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary input parameters for retrieving reservation violation details. It allows the client to specify criteria for filtering or identifying specific violations related to reservations.

ListParkingReservationsViolationsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body in JSON format for operations related to retrieving violations of reservations.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier for the reference associated with the reservation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message providing further details about the operation.

audit.description: Auditing information pertaining to the reservation.

ListParkingReservationsViolationsRespons.description: Response schema for the operation of retrieving violation reservations.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the reservation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the reservation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the reservation was created automatically.
